verdict.line: You lose if Irelia lands E's stun into a Q reset chain uncontested; you win if you catch her committing Q (Bladesurge) with no Mark to reset it.

brief.thesis: This is a measured coinflip (49.4% over 933 games) because both champions' threat is tied to a single cooldown: Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) only resets if it kills or hits a target Marked by her E (Flawless Duet), and K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) only pulls once it reaches 2 stacks. Whoever is forced to spend their key tool first loses the exchange. Your W (Path Maker) stun is the punish for a whiffed or committed Irelia Q, which is why the data shows K'Sante holding the solo-kill edge even in an even lane.

theirWindow.when: After her E (Flawless Duet) stun connects
theirWindow.what: The Mark from Flawless Duet lets her Q refresh off the follow-up dash-strike, stacking Ionian Fervor toward bonus on-hit damage. Expect the full stun-into-Q-into-autos chain, not a single poke.

yourWindow.when: Her Q and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Bladesurge and Flawless Duet down she has no gap closer and no stun. Step up, land two stacks of Q (Ntofo Strikes) for the pull, then follow with W (Path Maker)'s knockback stun.

start.why: Measured as the dominant start (49.9% over 1021 games, 89.5% pick) and answers the early poke from her charged W (Defiant Dance) without giving up trade damage.

boots.why: Highest sample and win rate (50.8% over 964 games, 88% pick); reduces the auto-attack chip she generates while stacking Ionian Fervor.

core.why: Cuts the self-heal on her Q (Bladesurge) and punishes her passive's on-hit reliance early.
The proc slow helps you actually land W (Path Maker) and R (All Out) on a champion whose only disengage is Q.
Grievous wounds answers her Q sustain directly, and the armor blunts max-stack Ionian Fervor damage.
Stacks resistances from the damage you absorb tanking her all-ins, scaling your side of extended fights.

situational.when: she builds lifesteal or sustain items to outlast your pressure
she's scaling hard on Ionian Fervor attack speed stacks and you need the slow-attacker aura

runes.keystoneWhy: The bonus health and proc damage keep you ahead on the stun-for-stun trades this lane is built around, and the sustain offsets her Q lifesteal.

summoners.why: The measured top pick (51.1% win rate, 74.2% pick rate); Teleport lets you reset after even trades instead of conceding wave pressure while this matchup is decided by cooldown timing, not all-in races.

playing.title: Punish her Q commitment
playing.detail: Bladesurge only resets on a kill or a Marked target; once she throws it at you clean, she has no gap closer back. Step forward with Q (Ntofo Strikes) and threaten W (Path Maker) during her recovery.

playing.title: Farm toward 2 Q stacks before engaging
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit and fires a pulling shockwave at 2 stacks on its 3.5s cooldown. Landing two in a row drags her into your follow-up instead of letting her walk away.

playing.title: Trade when her E is down
playing.detail: Flawless Duet runs 16s early down to 11.5s at max rank. With it on cooldown she has no CC to protect an all-in, so that's your window to step up.

playing.title: Respect her 850-range E before committing
playing.detail: Flawless Duet's converging blades stun and Mark anything caught between them at 850 range. Don't overextend past the wave where both blades can land, since a Mark there refreshes her Q.

playing.title: Charge W into her commitment, not her poke
playing.detail: Path Maker takes reduced damage while charging but has a visible wind-up before the knockback-stun dash. Throw it only after she's already dashed in with Q so she can't sidestep it.

playing.title: Build Thornmail before her passive snowballs
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor stacks bonus attack speed and then bonus on-hit damage every time she lands a spell. Thornmail's grievous wounds also cuts her Q sustain, so prioritize it once she's ahead on stacks.

playing.title: Save R for her all-in, not as an opener
playing.detail: All Out knocks an enemy through walls and transforms your kit for bonus damage and healing at reduced defenses, on a 120s cooldown that drops to 80s. Hold it to flip her engage into yours rather than opening with it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, and every win-rate/pick-rate figure here are measured from live games on the current patch (the 933-game K'Sante vs Irelia sample specifically); the cooldown-window and trade-timing analysis is our own read layered on top of that data.
